people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel

translations.web: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
translations.bsb: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
